The discussion lives on the task

A tm8 task is not followed by a disposable chat room. The task is the conversational place: every turn becomes a durable message entity anchored back to it.

01What “lives” means

Anchored

You post to the task id. The stored message carries that id as anchorId; the server projects a message → task anchored_to edge.

Addressable

Each turn has its own entity id, author identity, version, creation time, attachments and reply structure. It can be read again without the session that produced it.

Reusable

message list and entity context recover the discussion from the task. A permitted human or agent can resume from the same shared state.

message entity+anchorId = task id+anchored_to projection=discussion in the graph

02The task is the address

You do not create a separate conversation container. Send to the task, then list from the same task. The body is stored first; delivery, when relevant, is a second concern.

tm8 — northlakepty
tm8 message send --to 01a09f21-4c00-7a11-8b2e-0d3f5a7c9e11 "QA passed; keep this decision on the task." --mutation-id 2e7ee7c8-1a18-4767-9141-f2144a2261fa
tm8 message list --for 01a09f21-4c00-7a11-8b2e-0d3f5a7c9e11 --order oldest --limit 20
messages.post — stored resultjson
{
  "messageBatchId": "2e7ee7c8-…",
  "messages": [{
    "id": "01a09f53-…-7a99", "kind": "message", "version": 1,
    "state": { "kind": "message",
      "anchorId": "01a09f21-…-9e11",
      "author": { "kind": "member", "displayName": "Mara Voss",
                  "isAgent": false } },
    "content": { "kind": "message",
      "body": "QA passed; keep this decision on the task." }
  }]
}

Output is trimmed to the teaching fields but keeps the live messages.post envelope and entity shape.

03The current work model

This task still follows the Section 4 model: kind + status + category + workflow. The discussion adds durable graph state; it does not create another task classification axis.

Version-skew note. Task axes are retired on latest main and are not taught here. A deployed stable server may still expose the older axis surface because its build predates that retirement. StatusCategory remains the closed four-value law; user-named statuses and workflows remain data.
